```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(highcharter)
library(readr)

source(here::here("R", "model-timeline.R"))
source(here::here("R", "porsche.R"))

source_url <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jbkunst/motorsport-legends/",
  "main/data/cars/porsche_stuttcars_model_research.csv"
)

research_url <- "https://www.stuttcars.com/porsche-model-research/"

source_data <- read_csv(
  source_url,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  col_select = -c(image_data_uri, image_profile_data_uri)
)

porsche_records <- source_data |>
  transmute(
    Model = model_timeline_record_link(.data$model, .data$url),
    Photo = model_timeline_record_photo(.data$image_url),
    Profile = model_timeline_record_photo(.data$image_profile_url),
    Year = .data$year,
    `Year end` = .data$year_end,
    Category = .data$category,
    Section = .data$section,
    `Model family` = .data$model_family,
    `Model code` = .data$model_code,
    Generation = .data$generation,
    Engine = .data$engine,
    `Engine position` = .data$engine_position,
    `Displacement (cc)` = .data$displacement_cc,
    `Power (cv)` = .data$max_power_cv,
    `Power rpm` = .data$rpm_max_power,
    `Torque (Nm)` = .data$torque_nm,
    `Torque rpm` = .data$rpm_max_torque,
    `Top speed (km/h)` = .data$top_speed_kmh,
    `0-100 km/h (s)` = .data$acceleration_0_100_kmh_s,
    Production = .data$production_qty,
    `Production ongoing` = .data$production_is_ongoing,
    Description = .data$description
  )

cars <- porsche_prepare(source_data)
initial_model <- "959 Komfort"
```

::: {.model-timeline-intro}

An interactive data visualization of Porsche evolution from 1939 to 2026, comparing road cars, race cars, model families, engines, power, speed, and production. Data is drawn from [the model research collection assembled by Stuttcars](https://www.stuttcars.com/porsche-model-research/).
